He is [[Alder]]'s grandson and the final {{tc|Boss Trainer}} of the [[Black Tower]]{{sup/5|B2}}/[[White Treehollow]]{{sup/5|W2}}. ==In the core series games== Benga is a {{pkmn|Trainer}} who appears in {{B2W2}}. After the {{player}} has defeated [[Alder]] in [[Floccesy Town]] after becoming {{pkmn|Champion}}, Benga will rush in and tell his grandfather that he has successfully made it to the top of the [[Black Tower]] in [[Black City]]{{sup/5|B2}}/deepest part of the [[White Treehollow]] in [[White Forest]]{{sup/5|W2}}. Upon noticing the player, he urges them to challenge the facility as well and meet him there. Benga is encountered a couple times throughout the player's journey through the Black Tower{{sup/5|B2}}/White Treehollow{{sup/5|W2}}, until he is finally {{pkmn|battle}}d as the {{tc|Boss Trainer}} of Area 10, the final area of the facility. After being defeated, he tells the player to come meet him at Alder's house in Floccesy Town. If the player then returns to the house with an empty slot in their [[party]], Benga will give them a {{Shiny}} {{p|Gible}}{{sup/5|B2}}/{{p|Dratini}}{{sup/5|W2}} as a {{pkmn2|gift}}, before returning {{color2|000|Pokémon Black and White Versions 2|Black 2 and White 2}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Benga/Quotes}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Benga Adventures.png|thumb|120px|Benga in Pokémon Adventures]] Benga first appeared in ''[[PS541|Pink Slip]]''. He is a first-year student at the [[Aspertia City]] [[Pokémon academy|Trainers' School]], alongside {{adv|Blake}}, {{adv|Whitley}}, [[Hugh]], [[Leo]], {{adv|Yuki}}, {{adv|Yuko}}, and {{adv|Maya}}. On the first day of school, Benga fought in a battle against Blake, Hugh and Leo, which led to Benga's suspension due to damage caused to the classroom. After his suspension period had ended, Benga returned to school, only to find that his class had gone off to [[Castelia City]] on a trip. Following their tracks, Benga traveled to Castelia with [[Marlon]], only to witness the city getting frozen by the [[Plasma Frigate]]. Benga and Marlon found the class, unconscious but unharmed, and took them to the [[Marine Tube]] to recuperate. Once the class had woken up, Benga and Marlon explained everything to them, and revealed that they were gathering forces to help launch a counterattack against [[Team Plasma]]. By ''[[PS547|The Final Battle]]'', the Marine Tube had been frozen over, along with the rest of [[Undella Town]]. With the combined power of {{m|Fire Pledge}}, {{m|Grass Pledge}}, and {{m|Water Pledge}}, Benga, {{adv|Cheren}}, {{adv|Bianca}}, and [[Cedric Juniper]] managed to break through the ice and free everyone trapped inside. Benga and the others were transported to the abandoned [[N's Castle]]. The area had been set ablaze when the Plasma Frigate crashed into it, putting the Pokémon Team Plasma left behind at risk. Benga, {{adv|Black}}, {{adv|White}}, Blake, Whitley, Hugh, Cheren, Bianca, and Cedric combined the might of all three stages of the Unova first partner Pokémon and unleashed a triple Fire, Grass, and Water Pledge combination attack, successfully dousing the flames. In ''[[PS548|Epilogue]]'', Benga attended the Trainers' School graduation ceremony with his classmates. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |width=75 |trainer=Benga |stage1=Gible |pkmn=Gabite |gender=male |type1=Dragon |type2=Ground |img=Benga Gible Adventures.png |img_size=120px |cap=Benga's Gible |img2=Benga Gabite Adventures.png |img2_size=150px |epnum=PS541 |epname=Pink Slip |desc={{p|Gabite}} is Benga's first known Pokémon. None of Gabite's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |width=75 |trainer=Benga |stage1=Larvesta |pkmn=Volcarona |type1=Bug |type2=Fire |img=Benga Larvesta Adventures.png |img_size=120px |cap=Benga's Larvesta |img2=Benga Volcarona Adventures.png |img2_size=120px |epnum=PS541 |epname=Pink Slip |desc={{p|Volcarona}} is Benga's second known Pokémon. None of Volcarona's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |width=75 |trainer=Benga |stage1=Tepig |pkmn=Pignite |type1=Fire |type2=Fighting |img=Gorm Sigilyph Benga Tepig Adventures.png |img2=Benga Pignite Adventures.png |epnum=PS546 |epname=Giant Chasm |desc={{p|Pignite}} is Benga's third known Pokémon. Later, as a Pignite, it was used to break through the ice covering the Marine Tube. By combining its {{m|Fire Pledge}} with the other two Pledge moves, it successfully broke through, freeing everyone.
